title: Revolutionary War on Wednesday
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie cross the icy Delaware with George Washington on Christmas! / 杰克和安妮在圣诞节跟随乔治·华盛顿横渡结冰的特拉华河！🌳

q.en: Who is the commander-in-chief that Jack and Annie meet on the frozen riverbank?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在结冰的河岸边遇到的总司令是谁？

options.en: A captain who lives in Frog Creek
options.zh: 一位住在青蛙溪的队长

options.en: Thomas Paine, the writer of essays
options.zh: 托马斯·潘恩，那位写文章的作家

explain.en: The man in the dark cape and three-cornered hat who rode up on a white horse was George Washington, commander-in-chief of the American army. Jack recognized his face from pictures on dollar bills.
explain.zh: 那位披着深色斗篷、头戴三角帽、骑着白马出现的人正是美国军队总司令乔治·华盛顿。杰克从美元钞票上的肖像认出了他。

q.en: What writing do Jack and Annie find that is the 'something to send' for Morgan's library?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮找到的、可以作为摩根图书馆里「要寄出的东西」的文稿是什么？

options.en: A poem copied onto a school slate
A list of rules from the famous nurse Clara Barton
options.zh: 著名的护士克拉拉·巴顿写的一张守则清单

options.en: A sign with a poem about hope
A captain's farewell letter to his children
options.zh: 一位队长写给孩子们的告别信

explain.en: The captain gave Jack a farewell letter he had written to his children, Molly and Ben Sanders, saying Jack should only send it if the mission failed. This letter was the 'something to send.'
explain.zh: 队长交给杰克一封写给孩子们莫莉和本·桑德斯（Molly and Ben Sanders）的告别信，并说只有任务失败时才寄出。这封信就是「要寄出的东西」。

q.en: About how many American patriots gathered to cross the Delaware River?
q.zh: 大约有多少名美国爱国者聚集起来准备横渡特拉华河？

explain.en: Their research book said about 2,400 American patriots gathered on the west bank of the Delaware River in Pennsylvania to begin their secret mission.
explain.zh: 他们的参考书上写道，大约 2,400 名美国爱国者聚集在宾夕法尼亚州特拉华河西岸，准备开始秘密行动。

q.en: On which river does Washington's secret Christmas mission take place?
q.zh: 华盛顿的圣诞秘密行动发生在哪条河上？

explain.en: The patriots gathered by the Delaware River and crossed it on Christmas night to surprise the Hessians. Jack and Annie landed near its icy banks in Pennsylvania.
explain.zh: 爱国者们在特拉华河边集结，并在圣诞夜渡河奇袭黑森雇佣兵。杰克和安妮降落在宾夕法尼亚州结冰的河岸边。

q.en: What famous words does Washington read to his men to give them courage?
q.zh: 华盛顿为了让士兵们鼓起勇气，给他们朗读了哪句著名的话？

options.en: Give me liberty, or give me death
We hold these truths to be self-evident that all are equal
options.zh: 我们认为这些真理是不言而喻的：人人生而平等

options.en: These are the times that try men's souls
options.zh: 这是一个考验人们灵魂的时代

explain.en: Washington read from Thomas Paine's essay The Crisis: 'These are the times that try men's souls.' The captain later copied those very words into his letter to his children.
explain.zh: 华盛顿朗读了托马斯·潘恩《危机》中的句子：「这是一个考验人们灵魂的时代。」队长后来还把这句话抄进了给孩子们的信里。

q.en: How does Jack feel when he learns they are going to another war?
q.zh: 当杰克得知他们又要去打仗时，他是什么感受？

options.zh: 对摩根派他们去感到非常生气

explain.en: Jack sighed and said 'Another war,' because he hated the suffering he had seen in the Civil War. He and Annie went only because they had to help Morgan and save Camelot.
explain.zh: 杰克叹了口气说「又要打仗了」，因为他讨厌在南北战争中看到的那些苦难。他们去只是因为必须帮助摩根、拯救卡米洛特。

q.en: What animal does George Washington ride when he first appears?
q.zh: 乔治·华盛顿第一次出现时，骑着什么动物？

explain.en: Jack and Annie saw a man in a dark cape and three-cornered hat ride up on a white horse — it was George Washington, commander-in-chief.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮看到一位披着深色斗篷、头戴三角帽的人骑着一匹白马出现——那就是总司令乔治·华盛顿。

q.en: Which book do Jack and Annie use to travel back home to Frog Creek?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮用哪本书回到了青蛙溪的家？

options.zh: 那本关于宾夕法尼亚州的书
那本关于革命战争的书

options.en: A book all about George Washington
options.zh: 一本专门讲乔治·华盛顿的书

explain.en: Annie grabbed the Pennsylvania book, pointed to the picture of Frog Creek woods, and wished them home — just as they had done on earlier trips.
explain.zh: 安妮拿起那本关于宾夕法尼亚州的书，指着青蛙溪树林的照片许愿回家——和之前几次旅行一样。

q.en: On what date does Washington's secret crossing of the Delaware take place?
q.zh: 华盛顿秘密横渡特拉华河发生在哪一天？

options.zh: 1787 年 9 月 17 日，不过那是另一个故事了

explain.en: The research book said the crossing happened on Wednesday, December 25, 1776 — Christmas night — when Annie realized, 'Today's Christmas!'
explain.zh: 参考书里说渡河发生在 1776 年 12 月 25 日星期三——圣诞夜。安妮当时惊喜地说：「今天是圣诞节！」

q.en: Whose boat do Jack and Annie accidentally ride across the Delaware River?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮不小心搭上了谁的船渡过了特拉华河？

options.zh: 乔治·华盛顿和他的船员

options.en: The captain and his ragged men
options.zh: 那位队长和他衣衫褴褛的部下

explain.en: Annie climbed into the biggest boat, which turned out to be George Washington's. The crew pushed off before Jack could pull her out, so they rode across with the general and his men.
explain.zh: 安妮爬上了最大的那艘船，结果发现那是乔治·华盛顿的船。船夫在杰克把她拉出来之前就划走了，于是他们和将军及其部下一起渡了河。
